name: Submit Password Change Successfully
summary: An authenticated user submits the current password and an acceptable new password, and the password credential is replaced while the user remains on the password-change surface with success confirmation.

preconditions.description: The current durable identity is authenticated and has an existing password credential that can be replaced.

serverInteraction.intent: Replace the current authenticated user's password credential after validating the current password and the new password policy.

postconditions.expression: identity.passwordCredentialReplaced == true && identity.unchanged == true && session.authenticated == true
postconditions.description: The password credential is replaced without changing the durable identity or ending the authenticated session.

sourceReferences.note: ChangePasswordAsync validates the request and delegates credential replacement to IUserManager.
Existing presentation model establishes current password, new password, and confirm password as the user inputs.
Password Management scenario review models password change as one atomic submit action from a canonical authenticated password-change surface.
